notes: n=2^a5^b m, gcd(m,10)=1: Y = rev(E) s rev(s) E with E the padded digits of 2^a5^b is a palindrome divisible by 2^a5^b; 2phi(m(10^|Y|-1)) copies of Y are divisible by m (Euler). Multiples of 10 end in 0, so no palindrome. Lean main theorem A084043.A084044_main (Mathlib). Outside Lean: none.

sources.cite: M. Harminc, R. Sotak, Palindromic numbers in arithmetic progressions, Fibonacci Quart. 36 (1998) 259-262
sources.what: palindromic multiples exist for every n not divisible by 10

prior_art.note: Containment of n as a substring not covered by the 1998 result.
